portal-verified.subject: You're set up on BetterClose · Example Mortgage
portal-verified.textBody:
Hi Alex,

You've been added to Example Mortgage on BetterClose, with broker/LO portal access.

Sign in: https://betterclose.example.invalid/login?callbackUrl=%2Fteammate%2Fdashboard

Once you're in, you can:
  - Create instant fee quotes for your borrowers.
  - Share quotes with a public-view link and see when borrowers open them.
  - Your company is verified, so you can convert approved quotes into BetterClose closings.
  - Track every active file in your pipeline.

To create your first quote, sign in and choose Quotes -> New quote.

One-tap sign-in. No password to remember.

— The BetterClose Team

completed-savings.textBody:

123 Example Lane, Suite 2, Austin, TX

Funds have been disbursed and the deed is recorded. If you bought, the keys are yours. If you refinanced, the new loan is in place. Either way, this part is done.
